name: Can a garage renovation increase my property value?

mainEntity.name: Can a garage renovation increase my property value?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a well-executed garage renovation can significantly increase your property value, especially if it adds functional living space like an ADU or a dedicated home office. The return on investment often depends on the quality of the renovation, its functionality, and how it aligns with buyer demands in the local housing market.
acceptedAnswer.description: A well-done garage renovation, especially an ADU, can increase property value and appeal to buyers.
